data.name: Arqaam
data.gender_notes: Arqaam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘arqām’ meaning ‘a powerful or strong man’. This name signifies strength, courage and determination. The name Arqaam carries the meaning “Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arqaam usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arqaam is a name of God in Islam, meaning 'the one who is mighty, powerful, and strong.' It is believed that calling upon this name can bring strength and protection.
data.etymology: Arqaam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arqaam total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
